# Release notes

Óðinn hung on Yggdrasil for nine nights, and the Völuspá tells the story. The ætt of runes has eight letters.

The jarl files an issue, the worker proves it, and the merger lands it on the release branch.

Krzysztof Dudek wrote this sentence in English.

```
To jest kod: nie wiem, czy działa.
```

See `git log --oneline` and https://example.com/nie/wiem/czy for details.
